description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Log-Log4perl-1.58 board census (t/026FileApp.t rows 6-7: "the 0.33 Log::Log4perl::Appender::File bug which caused all messages to end up in the same file" -- PCL reproduces exactly that bug; Appender/File.pm:123 `my $fh = do { local *FH; *FH; };`).  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).

    sub mk { my $fh = do { local *FH; *FH; }; return $fh }
    my $a = mk(); my $b = mk();
    open $a, '>', '/tmp/g1' or die; open $b, '>', '/tmp/g2' or die;
    print $a "A\n"; print $b "B\n"; close $a; close $b;   # then read both files back
  perl 5.40.3: 1=[A;] 2=[B;]      PCL: 1=[] 2=[A;B;]
  Probe scratch/s526w2/pglob.pl.

perl: `local *FH` gives the glob a fresh GP for the scope; the value `*FH` returned from the do-block is a glob COPY that keeps that GP after `local` restores the old one, so each call yields a distinct, independent handle (the pre-Symbol::gensym idiom, still common on CPAN: IO::Handle-less modules, Log4perl, older Template, etc.).  PCL's `local *FH` restore appears to hand the same IO slot back, so the copy and the next call's glob alias.  The fix belongs in the runtime's glob localization (what the localized glob's VALUE carries out of the scope), cl/pcl-runtime.lisp -- not reduced further.
ROWS: Log-Log4perl t/026FileApp.t 6-7 (blessed to this task).


=== DONE (s529a) ===
Fixed in s529a commit 17bc0846 (2026-10-31, Opus).  %p-glob-save opens a frame per `local *NAME` scope (*p-local-glob-frames*); p-make-typeglob records the glob VALUES made from the localized name; %p-glob-clear (whole glob) also empties the IO slot + glob alias; %p-glob-restore hands the scope's four slots + IO to a fresh hidden name NAME__PCL_LOCAL_n (printed *PKG::NAME via *p-glob-display-names*) and re-points the recorded values, then restores the old slots / IO / alias.  `\*FH` taken in the scope is dropped from the frame (perl: a ref to the GV follows the name -- probed).  With no value taken, a handle an `open` in the scope gave the glob (%p-fh-register) is closed at the scope end (perl frees the GP; a 2000-call slurp loop does not leak); aliases (`local *FH = *STDOUT`, `= $fh`) never close.  STDIN/STDOUT/STDERR/ARGV/ARGVOUT keep their own IO localization.  Runtime functions only (the local macros' expansions are unchanged).  Probes scratch/s529a/pr/g1-g5 identical to perl (all fail on 77c7d9d7).  Guard Pl/t/local-glob-01.t rows 12-15 (file mode).  ir-spec 'local *name'.  Board: Log-Log4perl 026FileApp.t rows 6-7 out by edit; all 75 Log4perl files otherwise read their blessed rows exactly.
subject: SILENT WRONG: the anonymous-glob idiom `my $fh = do { local *FH; *FH }` returns the SAME glob on every call -- two handles opened through it share one stream (Log::Log4perl::Appender::File: two file appenders write into one file)
